title: Hamilton Lane — Q1 FY27 Beat + $1T AUM Milestone Confirms Evergreen Flywheel
summary: HLNE's Q1 FY27 print (Aug 4, 2026) delivered a $1.94 EPS beat (vs $1.57 est), revenue +56% YoY, AUM/AUS crossing $1.1T, and incentive fees +170% YoY. Promoted from Stalking to On Our Radar as the earnings release supplies the missing primary source and confirms the Evergreen semi-liquid private-markets flywheel.
catalyst: Hamilton Lane reported Q1 FY27 results on 2026-08-04: GAAP net income +50% YoY to $80.5M; non-GAAP EPS $1.94 (+48% YoY) vs consensus $1.57; total revenue $275M (+56% YoY) vs consensus $226M. Total AUM/AUS reached $1.1T ($146.3B discretionary + $914.1B non-discretionary). Incentive fees +170% YoY to $114M; management and advisory fees +21% to $161M. Stock rose 5.18% post-print then retraced to $100.81 as of 2026-08-05 close.
thesis: HLNE is the rare alt-asset platform combining best-in-class fundamentals (32.4% ROE, 32.8% profit margin, 24.3% D/E, Forward P/E ~14x post-print) with a durable non-cyclical fee base and a fast-growing semi-liquid Evergreen platform aimed at high-net-worth intermediated channels. The Q1 FY27 print quantifies what the June 3-insider cluster-buy at $14.2M was signaling — that management sees the AUM growth curve accelerating and the incentive-fee tail lengthening. The $1T AUM milestone is a psychological/business inflection: it removes the 'sub-scale relative to Ares/Blackstone' narrative and reframes HLNE as a credible top-5 private-markets platform.
counter_thesis: The bear case: the incentive-fee spike (+170%) is one-time carry realization from a vintage of funds harvesting exits into a strong late-cycle market, not a run-rate. If deal activity slows, incentive fees mean-revert and the recurring management-fee growth (+21%) doesn't justify the multiple. Private markets are more cyclical than the 'permanent capital' narrative suggests, and the Evergreen product is chasing a crowded HNW distribution channel where fee compression is coming. The stock is already up meaningfully into the print and the post-print pullback may be the market pricing in the exact 'incentive fees are a one-time' concern.

ticker_rationale.HLNE: Pure-play private-markets advisory + fund-of-funds + Evergreen semi-liquid platform. Screener score 70 (HOLD on the cusp of BUY), Dividend sleeve. Q1 FY27 supplies the primary evidence that the growth thesis is on-track.

trade_construction.entry_zone: HLNE $95-$102 (current $100.81; post-print pullback offers the entry — the $95 level is the pre-print consolidation and 50-day MA)
trade_construction.target_12mo: HLNE $130 (+29%) on 22x forward EPS applied to FY27E $5.90-$6.10 EPS (raised from ~$5.30 pre-print). Simply Wall St fair-value estimate cited at $130-$135 range
trade_construction.stop_loss: HLNE $80 (-21%) — breaks below the pre-cluster-buy floor and the 200-day MA; would signal the AUM growth is decelerating or Evergreen distribution is stalling

confidence_note: Trade construction is anchored to the Aug-4 post-print $99.83 close and analyst fair-value ranges rather than a bottom-up DCF. To promote to High Conviction: (1) secure a second primary source specifically quantifying Evergreen platform run-rate fees (an IR deck breakout or industry primary source), (2) confirm the incentive-fee lift is sustainable rather than one-time carry harvest via review of the next quarter's disclosures, (3) refresh consensus FY27 EPS revisions and sell-side target-price consensus.

catalyst_calendar.event: Q2 FY27 quarter-end — Evergreen platform monthly flows updates

HLNE.action: Initiate half-position on next pullback into $95-100 zone

risks: Incentive fees (~40% of Q1 FY27 revenue) mean-revert if private-markets deal activity slows
Evergreen HNW platform faces fee compression from Ares, Blackstone, and Apollo's competing semi-liquid vehicles
General-market drawdown compresses private-markets valuations and slows fundraising
Regulatory scrutiny on HNW distribution of private-markets products (SEC accredited-investor thresholds)

invalidation.trigger: Two consecutive quarters of AUM/AUS growth below 5% YoY
Q2 FY27 incentive fees fall >50% QoQ, confirming one-time carry harvest hypothesis
Evergreen platform monthly flows turn negative for two consecutive months
HLNE closes below $80 on a monthly basis
